name: Grand Larceny
note: R8.17, Module R2 SSD p.69. The largest Orion we have at 180 BPV, and the only one that breaks the faction's own patterns in three places. STEALTH IS +1 ECM, not the +2 every other Orion carries - read off the data table, not assumed. Its damage control track has SEVEN steps (6/4/4/2/2/2/0) where every other Orion has six. And it CANNOT land on planets by any means other than a crash landing (P2.431), where the rest of the fleet lands freely. FOUR CENTERLINE MOUNTS printed as a 2x2 block, declared as one run of four (owner, 2026-10-20) - the first run of four in the data, so it seats two separate two-mount weapons (A+B and C+D) or one across B+C, and never A+D. Its sheet says nothing about adjacency either way, unlike the DBR's capitals, so this is the owner's ruling rather than a reading. The two drone racks are type-C and fire on a 360 arc; their sheet note, 'THIS SHIP'S RACKS ALWAYS HAD TWO RELOADS', is just what a type-C carries, and the +1 every Orion rack gains in Y175 comes from the faction rule. Carries an EMERGENCY BRIDGE beside its bridge and auxiliary control. NOT MODELLED: the Y170 plasma carronade and the sabot refit (Module R10), the MINELAYER REFIT (R8.R1), and (R8.R3) for option mount firing arcs - none of which we have read.
